[[Kelvei, the Legendary Observer]] is an [[Asura]] NPC found in the [[Mistlock Observatory]]. Speaking with Kelvei will give you [[Theory of the Finite Result]], which is necessary to unlock the [[Legendary Backpacks|Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result]] [[achievement]].

After using the Theory of the Finite Result, Kelvei will offer advice on how to complete various parts of the achievement left unfinished.

== Dialogue ==
:Welcome to Mistlock Observatory inside the [[Fractals of the Mists]]! Please don't mind the mess, we're doing science.
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What's that on your back?''
::On my back is the state-of-the-art reverse front aesthetic covering and "ooh-ahh" device. It takes time and effort to build one, but if you're interested, I'll guide you through the process.
::<small>'''(if the player hasn't unlocked the Ad Infinitum achievement)'''</small>
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''How do I get started?''
:::<small>'''(If player does not have the item in inventory)'''</small>
:::This book should help guide you in these initial steps. <small>'''(Receives the item [[Theory of the Finite Result]])'''</small>
:::<small>'''(If player has the item in inventory)'''</small>
:::You should already have my book in your inventory. Read it to get started!
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''I'm good, thanks.''

=== Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result ===
<small>The following dialogue is only available after unlocking the [[Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result]] collection.</small>
:Welcome to Mistlock Observatory inside the [[Fractals of the Mists]]! Please don't mind the mess, we're doing science.
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What's that on your back?''
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need some help.''
::What can I help you with?
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need help with one of the challenge items.''
:::Which challenge item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Jade Kraken Timed Mote|Jade Maw timed mote]]?''
::::The Jade Maw timed mote requires you to defeat the legendary [[Jade Maw]] in under 5 minutes. The timer starts the second a party member reaches its platform.
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Aquatic Ruin Challenge Mote|Aquatic Ruins challenge mote]]?''
::::The Aquatic Ruins challenge mote requires you to take on the [[Jellyfish Beast]] on any difficulty without the ability to use your primary heal skill. Gather a coordinated group and dodge his attacks. Good luck!
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.''
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need help with one of the puzzle items.''
:::What puzzle item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Burning Frozen Core]]?''
::::The Burning Frozen Core is produced by collecting remains from the [[The Frozen Maw|Maw world boss]] in [[Wayfarer Foothills]] and imbuing them inside the heart of the [[Volcanic Fractal|Volcanic fractal]].
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Unstable Magically Charged Infusion Sample]]?''
::::Inside [[Bloomhunger]]'s domain in the [[Swampland Fractal|Swampland fractal]], a fissure has opened. A [[+4 Agony Infusion]] should be strong enough to contain a sample.
::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Where can I find a +4 Agony Infusion?''
:::::Artificers can combine two agony infusions of the same value to create a more powerful version. For example, 2 +3 infusions will create a single +4 infusion. You can also buy these items on the [[Trading Post|trading post]].
:::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
:::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.''
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need help with one of the miscellaneous items.''
:::Which other item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Ascalonian Fractal Field Research Paper]]?''
::::Dessa sent field researchers into the fractals. The [[Urban Battleground Fractal|Urban Battlegrounds]] Field Researcher sent word deep from behind enemy lines that they needed a [[Fractal Journal]] to finish their work.
::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''How do I get my hands on a Fractal Journal?''
:::::By completing 14{{sic|28}} daily recommended fractals, you can combine their [[Fractal Research Page]]s to create a Field Journal of your accomplishments. These journals will help field researchers with their work.
:::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
:::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.''
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I have all the items you know about. What's next?''
:::I've helped you all I can with this collection. Once you complete the collection, purchase the [[Recipe: Finite Result|Tier 1 back recipe]] from BUY-4373 and craft it. Return to me once you've done that and we can continue.
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''OK, thanks!''
:{{dialogue icon|end}} ''OK!''

;Returning after completing Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result to begin Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound
:Welcome back to Mistlock Observatory. How goes your quest for your own legendary BACKPIECE?
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I've completed my Tier 1 back item. I'm ready for the next step!''
::<small>'''(If player does not have the item in inventory)'''</small>
::This item will get you started on your next task. This time the challenges are greater, but I feel you can do this. Speak with me after you have read the guide if you need advice. <small>'''(Receives the item [[Theory of the Upper Bound]])'''</small>
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::<small>'''(If player has the item in inventory)'''</small>
::You should already have my book in your inventory. Read it to get started!
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:{{dialogue icon|end}} ''OK!''

::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''

::::The Thaumanova timed mote requires you to complete the entire Thaumanova Reactor fractal in under 5{{sic|incorrect, players have 20 minutes}} minutes. The timer starts the second the party blows open the entrance to the reactor.
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.''
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need help with one of the puzzle items.''
:::What puzzle item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Jade Maw Fang]]?''
::::A member of Dessa's krewe studying the Jade Maw has one of its fangs. He is looking to exchange it for a [[Vinewrath Tendril|Vinewrath tendril]], obtained by assisting the Pact forces in the Silverwastes.
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Pollenated Ice Elemental Core|Pollenated Ice Elemental Core in a Jar]]?''
::::Shaman Lornarr Dragonseeker in the Snowblind fractal draws power from a special Ice Elemental Core. Take it from him and combine it with Pollen Clouds beneath one of the towers in the Silverwastes.
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Weak Magically Charged Infusion Sample]]?''
::::Hidden inside the Molten Furnace fractal, a fissure has opened. A [[+6 Agony Infusion]] should be strong enough to contain a sample.
::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Where can I find a +6 Agony Infusion?''
:::::Artificers can combine two agony infusions of the same value to create a more powerful one. For example, two +3 infusions will create a single +4 infusion. Also find these items at the trading post.
:::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
:::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you about something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.''
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I need help with one of the miscellaneous items.''
:::Which other item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Molten Alliance Fractal Field Research Paper|Molten Alliance Field Research Paper]]?''
::::Dessa sent field researchers into the fractals. The Molten Furnace Field Researcher has studied the technology of the Molten Berserker and his friend. They need a Fractal Journal to finish their work.
::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''How do I get my hands on a Fractal Journal?''
:::::By completing 14{{sic|28}} daily recommended fractals, you can combine their Fractal Research Pages to create a Field Journal of your accomplishments. These journals will help field researchers with their work.
:::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
:::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''What can you tell me about the [[Beta Fractal Capacitor (Infused)|Beta Fractal Capacitor]]?''
::::The Beta Fractal Capacitor can be obtained by combining a [[Prototype Fractal Capacitor (Ascended)|Prototype Fractal Capacitor]] with a [[Shard of Crystallized Mists Essence]]{{sic|Glob of Coagulated Mists Essence}}, a [[Gift of Ascension]], and 250 [[Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm]] in the Mystic Forge.
::::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I want to ask you something else.''
::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''I have a question about a different item.'' <small>(see [[#Notes]])</small>
::::Which challenge item do you need help with?
:::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Thanks.''
:{{dialogue icon|end}} ''OK!''
